product_name_specific: A-Class, B-Class, CLA, EQA, EQB, GLA, GLB
risk_description: Improper torque of the screws on the brake caliper housing can cause the screw connections to become loose. As a result, the braking performance would be reduced and components of the brake caliper may be lost, increasing the risk of accidents.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the  Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
